pages.scope: Current RTL: pipelined attention value pass
pages.graph:
flowchart TB N0["Causal scores: timesteps 0 through position_q
Read a score with its timestep tag"] N1["Four-stage exp interpolation + timestep tags
Whole pipeline stalls when its output cannot issue a V read"] N2["Reserve one of eight slots before each KV V request
Store probability U25 + timestep; five-edge KV read latency"] N3["Accepted V responses fill the reserved FIFO
Eight vectors, each 32 signed S24 lanes"] N4["Capture oldest probability / V pair into operand registers
Preserve FIFO order; wait for math_in_ready"] N5["Issue shared llm_math SIMD: 32 signed lane products
Four stages of validity / timestep tags track the products"] N6["Retire lane products in timestep order
Accumulate S56 products into S64 attention_acc_q lanes"] N7["Drain exp, KV, operands, product tags and math_busy
Then launch unchanged exact attention normalization"] N0 --> N1 N1 --> N2 N2 --> N3 N3 --> N4 N4 --> N5 N5 --> N6 N6 --> N7

pages.title: llm_soc — attention credits and completion
pages.scope: Current RTL: pipelined attention value pass
pages.graph:
flowchart TB N0["Launch when QK scores complete without a fault
Reset score / request / response / capture / retire counters"] N1["Exp output requests V only with a reserved slot available
request - capture < 8, or capture frees a slot this clock"] N2["KV responses use slots reserved at request acceptance
Capture oldest pair; math ready controls operand consumption"] N3["Retirement requires both tagged validity and math_product_valid
Final retired timestep alone does not finish the operator"] N4["Normal completion waits for all ownership to drain
Exp empty; request = response = capture; no operand / product; math idle"] N5["Completion permits exact normalization / operator progression
